title: A Station You Can Ship: A Link, a Watchdog, an Enable Switch, Commands That Are Retried and a Shutdown That Is in Order

questions.question: Why is a zero sent when the key is up and not nothing?
options: A zero is a command to stop, and it has to arrive
questions.explanation: The key-up request of 1 m/s sent 0 and the robot received it.

questions.question: The robot goes quiet and comes back with the key still held. What is the speed?
options: Zero: the interlock does not start by itself
questions.explanation: It was 0 until the key was let go and pressed.

questions.question: What connects the watchdog to the interlock?
options: on_health, which sets whether the link is alive from the health of the robot

questions.question: The robot loses the first answer to a command. How many times does it apply the command?
What speed does a retry send?
options: The speed the command had when it was first sent, kept with its number
The speed that is asked now
questions.explanation: The retry sends the speed it kept.

questions.question: What does a second stop() do?
options: Nothing: the first closed everything, once
